test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Women Transforming India (WTI) Awards have been hosted since 2018, under the aegis of _______ with a special focus on entrepreneurship.

options.text: Department of Science & Technology’s Women Entrepreneurship Platform
Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade’s Women Entrepreneurship Platform

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**NITI Aayog’s Women Entrepreneurship Platform.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​​**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog has introduced the Women Entrepreneurship **Platform in order to provide a welcoming atmosphere for aspiring and established women entrepreneurs nationally (WEP). **SIDBI and NITI Aayog **have teamed up to support this programme.
 
• **Three pillars serve as the foundation** of the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP): Iccha Shakti (motivation): This stands for inspiring prospective female business owners to launch their ventures.** Gyaan Shakti (power of knowledge)**: This stands for giving female entrepreneurs the necessary **information and ecosystem support.**
 
• **NITI Aayog's annual project, **the WTI Awards, honours the inspiring and innovative efforts of India's female leaders and change-makers. The** Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) of NITI Aayog **has been in charge of hosting the Awards since 2018, with a particular focus on **entrepreneurship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​​**

 
• In **addition to providing services** like free credit ratings, mentorship, funding support for women entrepreneurs, apprenticeship, and corporate partnerships,** WEP will assist entrepreneurs** by encouraging them to share their entrepreneurial journeys, stories, and experiences in order to** foster mutual learning.**
 
• A **Tech Major in India, Google unveiled** its brand-new "Women Will" web platform. This initiative aims to mentor women who aspire to start their **own businesses.**
 
• The **International Labour Organization's** (ILO-WED) Women's Entrepreneurship Development programme works to support aspiring and established **female entrepreneurs** who want to launch, manage, and expand their businesses as well as to create the conditions for inclusive, resilient, and **sustainable economies.**
